# Samba Agentic Slackbot - Complete Tool & Capability Inventory
Generated: 2026-02-08

## Summary

Samba is an advanced Slack-based AI agent powered by Claude Opus 4.6 with comprehensive tool integration. The system features:

- **8 MCP Servers** (3 internal Samba, 5 external)
- **14 Agent Skills** (local skill packages with specialized workflows)
- **3 Core Built-in Tools** (memory, code execution, summarize)
- **Tool Search** enabled for 500+ integrations via Rube/Composio
- **Generative Media** (Imagen for images, Veo for videos)

---

## 1. MCP Servers Configuration

Location: `.orion/config.yaml` under `mcp_servers:`

### 1.1 Internal Samba MCP Servers

| Server Name | Type | Auth | Description | URL |
|------------|------|------|-------------|-----|
| **audience-manager** | HTTP | GCP Identity | TV viewership data, sports audiences (NFL, college football, NBA), demographics, media consumption analytics, audience segmentation and targeting | `https://audience-manager-mcp-vjlizxe2vq-uc.a.run.app/mcp` |
| **msci-reports** | HTTP | GCP Identity | Data reports, analytics dashboards, business intelligence, data analysis | `https://report-generator-mcp-vjlizxe2vq-uc.a.run.app/mcp` |

**Auth Type: GCP Identity**
- Cloud Run services require IAM authentication
- Identity tokens fetched at runtime from GCP metadata server
- Implementation: `src/tools/mcp/gcp-auth.ts`

### 1.2 External MCP Servers

| Server Name | Type | Auth | Description | URL |
|------------|------|------|-------------|-----|
| **exa** | HTTP | None | Web search and code context (tools: `web_search_exa`, `get_code_context_exa`) | `https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp` |
| **rube** | HTTP | Bearer | 500+ app integrations via Composio (Slack, GitHub, Notion, Google, etc.) | `https://rube.app/mcp` |

**Rube/Composio Details:**
- Bearer token configured in headers
- Provides 500+ integrations discoverable via tool search
- Alternative config via env vars: `RUBE_MCP_ENABLED`, `RUBE_MCP_URL`
- Implementation: `src/config/mcp-servers.ts`

## 3. Core Built-in Tools (Non-MCP)

Location: `src/tools/` directory

### 3.1 Core Tool Definitions

| Tool Name | Type | Description | Implementation |
|-----------|------|-------------|----------------|
| **memory** | Built-in | Persistent memory storage scoped to user/thread. Read/write/list files in GCS | `src/tools/memory/` |
| **code_execution** | Anthropic | Execute Python/Bash code in sandboxed environment. Provided by Anthropic SDK | Anthropic SDK native |
| **summarize_conversation** | Built-in | Summarize Slack conversations, threads, channels with smart context routing | `src/tools/summarize/` |

### 3.2 Memory Tool Details

**Scopes:**
- `user` - Per-user persistent storage
- `thread` - Per-thread storage (conversation-specific)
- `global` - Workspace-wide storage

**Operations:**
- Read files with line numbers
- Write files (replaces or merges content)
- Delete files
- List directory contents
- Copy files between scopes

**Storage Backend:** Google Cloud Storage
- Bucket: `gs://orion-agent-memory/`
- Path structure: `{scope}/{userId}/[{threadTs}/]{filename}`
- Implementation: `src/tools/memory/storage.ts`, `src/tools/memory/paths.ts`

### 3.3 Code Execution Tool

- **Provider:** Anthropic SDK native capability
- **Languages:** Python, Bash
- **Sandboxed:** Yes
- **File Output:** Supports creating files returned to Claude
- **Beta Header:** `gemini-2.5` enabled for auto-context

### 3.4 Summarize Tool

**Tool Name:** `summarize_conversation`

**Features:**
- Thread URL detection and parsing
- Context-aware routing (thread vs conversation)
- Time range parsing (e.g., "last 24 hours", "since Monday")
- Smart participant extraction
- Conversation type detection (DMs, channels, threads)

**Supported Conversation Types:**
- Threads (with URL or in-context)
- Channels
- Group DMs
- Direct Messages

## 4. Tool Search & Discovery

### 4.1 Tool Search Configuration

**Location:** `src/config/environment.ts`

```typescript
toolSearch: {
  enabled: process.env.TOOL_SEARCH_ENABLED !== 'false', // Default: true
  coreTools: ['memory', 'code_execution', 'summarize'], // Never deferred
}
```

**Environment Variables:**
- `TOOL_SEARCH_ENABLED` - Enable/disable tool search (default: true)
- `CORE_TOOLS` - Comma-separated list of tools always in context

### 4.2 Model Support

**Supported Models:**
- `claude-sonnet-4-*` (4.5+)
- `claude-opus-4-*` (4.5+)

**Not Supported:**
- `claude-3-*` models
- `claude-3-5-*` models

**Detection:** `src/agent/model-capabilities.ts`

### 4.3 How It Works

When tool search is enabled:
1. Core tools are always in context (no `defer_loading`)
2. MCP tools and skill tools are annotated with `defer_loading: true`
3. Claude discovers tools on-demand via built-in `tool_search_tool_bm25` and `tool_search_tool_regex`
4. Reduces token usage when many tools are available (500+ via Rube)

**Rube/Composio Integration:**
- 500+ app integrations (Slack, GitHub, Notion, Google, Linear, Jira, Asana, Airtable, etc.)
- Tools discovered dynamically via tool search
- Examples: `rube__github_create_issue`, `rube__slack_send_message`, `rube__notion_create_page`

**Tool Registry Location:** `src/tools/registry.ts`

| Type | Naming Pattern | Example |
|------|----------------|---------|

| **MCP** | `{serverName}__{toolName}` | `rube__github_create_issue`, `exa__web_search_exa` |
| **Skill** | `{skillName}__{toolName}` | `xlsx__create_spreadsheet`, `pdf__extract_text` |

## 6. Architecture Summary

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Slack User Request                        │
└───────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              Orion Agent (Claude Opus 4.6)                   │
│  - System prompt with skill context                          │
│  - Tool search enabled (defer_loading)                       │
│  - Agent loop: src/agent/loop.ts                             │
└───────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              Unified Tool Registry                           │
│  - Static tools (memory, code_execution, summarize)          │
│  - MCP tools (8 servers × N tools)                           │
│  - Skill tools (14 skills × N tools)                         │
│  Location: src/tools/registry.ts                             │
└───────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                ┌───────────┼───────────┐
                ▼           ▼           ▼
        ┌───────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐
        │  Static   │ │   MCP    │ │  Skill   │
        │  Handler  │ │  Client  │ │  Sandbox │
        └───────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────┘
                            │
                ┌───────────┼───────────────────┐
                ▼           ▼                   ▼
        ┌─────────────┐ ┌─────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐
        │   Samba     │ │  External   │ │   Genmedia   │
        │  MCP (2)    │ │  MCP (2)    │ │   MCP (2)    │
        └─────────────┘ └─────────────┘ └──────────────┘
        • audience-mgr  • exa           • imagen (image)
        • msci-reports  • rube (500+)   • veo (video)
```
